snippet.title: Star Wars Takeover | Official Trailer | New Club Penguin
snippet.description: It's been fifteen years since the fall of The Final Order at The Battle of Exegol and Lothal is holding a historical event to teach young Jedi Padawans and Sith Apprentices about the past. All are welcome at this landmark event later this month!
